abstract: Cervical teratomas are rare neoplasms which have been infrequently reported. During the period of July 1974 to April 1982, six newborns with this lesion were seen at the Mott Children's Hospital. There were three males and three females, all of whom presented at birth with large semicystic neck masses. In four infants, calcifications were seen on x-ray. Four patients required intubation within the first hours of life for respiratory distress. One child of 33 weeks gestation expired prior to operation because of a hypoplastic left ventricle and bilateral hypoplastic lungs. Cord blood T3 and T4 values were normal in three patients; the TSH was elevated 1.5 and 2 times normal in two of these infants. Four neonates were operated upon within 24 hours of birth and suffered no postoperative complications. One baby presented on the third day of life and expired three hours postoperatively from persistent respiratory distress. The tumors were well encapsulated and arose from or were surrounded by a lobe of the thyroid gland. In each case, the tumor was removed by performing a total thyroid lobectomy. The presence of normal thyroid tissue at the resection margin (in the isthmus) was verified by frozen section. One patient presented with cervical node metastases but is currently free of disease one year postoperatively. These six cases bring the total reported cases in the literature to 136. The 80% mortality in cases not operated upon has been reduced to 15% by prompt operation. This series substantiates the significant respiratory distress that can occur in newborns with cervical teratomas and confirms the need for emergency surgery in this group of patients.
abstract_ja: 頚部奇形腫はまれな腫瘍であり、報告例は少ない。1974年7月から1982年4月までに、Mott小児病院で6例の新生児が診察された。男児3例、女児3例で、全例が出生時に大きな半嚢胞性の頚部腫瘤を呈した。4例ではX線で石灰化が認められた。4例は出生後数時間以内に呼吸窮迫のため気管挿管を要した。妊娠33週の1例は、左心室低形成と両側肺低形成のため手術前に死亡した。臍帯血のT3およびT4の値は3例で正常であった。TSHは、このうち2例で正常値の1.5倍および2倍に上昇していた。出生後24時間以内に4例が手術を受け、術後合併症は認められなかった。出生3日目に来院した1例は、手術の3時間後に持続する呼吸窮迫のため死亡した。腫瘍は被膜に覆われ、甲状腺葉から生じるか、甲状腺葉に囲まれていた。全例で甲状腺葉全摘術により腫瘍を切除した。切除断端における正常甲状腺組織の存在(峡部)を、術中迅速病理で確認した。1例は頚部リンパ節転移を伴って来院したが、術後1年の時点で病変は認められない。これら6例により、文献上の報告例は計136例となった。手術を受けなかった症例の死亡率80%は、迅速な手術により15%に低下した。本研究により、頚部奇形腫の新生児では重篤な呼吸窮迫が起こりうること、またこの群では緊急手術が必要であることが確認された。
